newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian palm olein unchanged in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian palm olein unchanged in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were unchanged in quiet late trading on Thursday, traders said.

They said palm olein was unchanged at 1,400-05 rupiah/kg in Jakarta. But crude palm oil (CPO) was higher at 1,239.5 rupiah/kg at a 500-tonne tender in the North Sumatran city of Medan, against Tuesday's offer prices of 1,225 rupiah/kg.
The market was closed on Wednesday for a Hindu holiday.
"The market is quiet today and people are waiting for what will happen in the Malaysian market tomorrow," said one trader.
"But we expect olein prices to pick up because of the rise in CPO," he added.
Traders said they did not want to sell at lower prices since the CPO tender price was high. "It will not be profitable for us to sell at a low price...nobody will do it," said one trader.
Traders earlier said export prices for crude palm oil and palm olein were better than local values.
Data from Belawan Port showed that the MT Gogoman will leave the North Sumatran port on Friday for India with 3,500 tonnes of palm oil.
